contractor.name: AGM Fitout
contractor.address: Sheikh Zayed Road, near Oasis Centre, Office No. 13-11, Adel Mohammed Ali Jassim Al Marzouqi Bldg, Dubai

clauses.title: Identification and Documentation
clauses.text: Client identification and title deed must be submitted before the commencement of work.

clauses.title: Materials to be Provided by Client
clauses.text: Materials to be provided by the Client are listed in Section B above (Floor & wall tiles, Lights, Sanitaryware for bathrooms, Kitchen appliances).

clauses.title: Site Inspection and Handover
clauses.text: Site handover and technical inspections shall occur prior to commencement of physical works.

clauses.title: Permits and Authority Approvals
clauses.text: Client is responsible for obtaining all necessary approvals and permits before the commencement of work. Client shall provide the Contractor with supporting documentation reasonably required by authority to grant renovation permit. Payments of any permit fees, such as third-party insurance (if applicable), security deposit, community fees, etc. will be settled by Client.

clauses.title: Design Development and Material Selection
clauses.text: Design development and support with material selection are included in the Scope of Works and Contract Value and are expected to be completed within 2 weeks from contract signature. (if applicable)

clauses.title: Work Commencement on Site
clauses.text: Design development and material selection work will commence within 2 working days after the date of receipt of the first milestone payment by the Contractor (advance payment). Work on site shall commence in the first week of Mar, (if the advance payment is made by 16th Feb).

clauses.title: Project Timeline
clauses.text: The project timeline is estimated at 50 to 55 working days from start of site work, contingent upon availability of Client-provided material at the site.

clauses.title: Project Delays and Penalties
clauses.text: Delay: In the event of delay for reasons not attributable to the Client the Client can deduct a delay penalty from the Contractor as follows: 1% of contract price for each week the completion of the project is delayed. If the Contractor fails to finish the renovation, the Client can, upon informing the Contractor in writing, contract another company to complete the renovation at the cost of the Contractor.

clauses.title: Delivery and Material Offloading
clauses.text: All materials must be received within the contract location (no material offloading). Additional charges will apply if Client requests Contractor to offload delivery of materials ordered by the Client.

clauses.title: Material Breakage and Handling
clauses.text: Material breakage, contractor not responsible in case of any material breakage while offloading or installation, unless the damage caused because of lack of attention or neglection.

clauses.title: Suspension of Work
clauses.text: The contractor retains the right to suspend work in the event of (1) delayed Client payments or (2) delay in delivery of Client-provided material, with rescheduling of work to be determined accordingly.

clauses.title: Variations and Additional Scope
clauses.text: Any variations to the agreed scope will be agreed by the Parties and will be subject to additional costs. Contractor will not perform furniture assembly or delivery offloading from 3rd parties.

clauses.title: Sample Approvals and Scope Submission
clauses.text: Contractor shall prepare and submit the samples, the scope of work to Client.

clauses.title: Customized Items & Written Approval
clauses.text: The contractor shall ensure that any customized items/ sketches and / or visual representations shall be approved in writing by the Client.

clauses.title: Client Order Approvals
clauses.text: Items will not be ordered until the Client has approved.

clauses.title: Direct Client Merchandise Purchases
clauses.text: Should Merchandise be ordered by the Client and be sent directly to the Client. The Contractor is not responsible for such purchases.

clauses.title: Common Areas Protection and Indemnification
clauses.text: The Contractor will make sure that common areas are taken care off and no damage is made. The Contractor shall be liable for any damage to any 3rd party or community property/facilities caused by the Contractor and shall indemnify the Client from any costs in relation to the same. The Client reserves the right to deduct the cost of any damage caused by the Contractor from payments due to Contractor under this contract. If there is any damage done by Contractor to 3rd parties and such damage cannot be repaired by the Contractor, it will be documented and if there are any fines, will be settled from the last payment.

clauses.title: Third-Party Contractors and Site Rules
clauses.text: No third-party contractor to work at the site unless Contractor is informed about scope and time, Our company is not responsible for any damage or breakage that occurs on the site in the event of a violation of this clause, Furthermore, any such presence requires a prior written Letter of No Objection from our side, and a signed undertaking letter from the other contractor formally accepting full responsibility for their presence and actions, contractor not responsible for any damage of the client belongs at the site unless proven, or will be charged to the subcontractors.

clauses.title: Payment Milestones and Schedule
clauses.text: Payment Terms shall strictly adhere to the agreed 4-stage milestone schedule (40% Advance, 25% Tiling, 20% Woodwork, 15% 1-month PDC).

clauses.title: Method of Payment and Currency
clauses.text: All payments under this Contract shall be made in AED by wire transfer of funds to the Contractor's bank account.

clauses.title: Warranty Period
clauses.text: The Contractor provides a 12-months warranty on the work performed by the Contractor under the Contract. This warranty does not cover modifications made by the Client to Contractor's work and any items not included in the scope of work in the Quotation.

clauses.title: Compliance with UAE Laws and Regulations
clauses.text: By signing this Contract, the Contractor guarantees that he will follow the applicable laws and regulations of UAE, having all the legal documents and insurances to execute this renovation.

clauses.title: No-Smoking Policy
clauses.text: Smoking inside the Property is strictly prohibited.

clauses.title: Electrical Safety and Shift Shutdown
clauses.text: Main electricity shall be switched off after every shift or when the Property is left under no supervision to avoid fire. If a third party is working on the Property when the Contractor is not present, the Contractor will not handle responsibility for this.

clauses.title: Worker Welfare and Organization
clauses.text: Welfare for Contractor's site staff, such as drinking water, food, prayer area etc are the Contractors responsibility to organize.

clauses.title: Waste Debris Disposal & Site Cleanliness
clauses.text: The Contractor is responsible for removing and dumping waste material and debris to an approved dumping area or facility and the cost of waste material removal and dumping is included in the fixed Contract Price. Contractor will not hold responsibility for dumping third party material, charge will apply if the Contractor must do so at the request of the Client.

clauses.title: Unrelated Client Equipment and Goods
clauses.text: Any materials or equipment supplied or stored at the work site by the Client that are unrelated to the scope of work agreed upon in this contract fall under the sole responsibility of the Client. Our company is not responsible for protecting these materials against loss, theft, damage, or any harm that may befall them.

clauses.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
clauses.text: Issues not regulated by this Contract shall be governed by the provisions of the current legislation of the UAE and the Emirate of Dubai.
